Job Description
Join the Process Intelligence team at JPMorgan Chase to investigate how people, processes, and technology shape work. We start with the decision leaders need to make, then use relevant evidence to test assumptions and identify improvements that benefit employees, customers, and the business.
As a Data Scientist at JPMorgan Chase, you will work with business partners, researchers, engineers, and senior team members to turn business questions into analytical studies. Using Python, SQL, and statistical methods, with machine learning where appropriate, you will combine data with operational context and communicate what the evidence supports and what remains uncertain.
Job Responsibilities
Clarify the business decision, question, and assumptions with stakeholders and senior team members before selecting data or methods.
Assess data relevance, quality, and limitations, and recommend additional evidence or methods when needed.
Prepare and integrate data from task mining, process mining, operational records, surveys, and interviews, within approved access.
Apply statistical methods, and machine learning where appropriate, in reproducible analyses suited to the question.
Identify variation, workarounds, rework, and overlooked effort, and test competing explanations.
Explore unexpected patterns and refine questions as findings emerge.
Avoid treating activity data as a direct measure of effort or performance, or associations as causes.
Communicate findings as clear recommendations tied to decision options, uncertainty, and next steps.
Analyze work systems at an aggregate level, following privacy and responsible-use requirements, rather than rating individual employees.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, with quantitative training such as econometrics or research methods.
1–3 years of experience in data science or applied research.
Ability to turn an ambiguous business question into an analysis plan and justify the data and methods chosen.
Sound judgment in assessing evidence quality, testing assumptions, and communicating uncertainty.
Proficiency in Python, SQL, pandas, and scikit-learn.
Knowledge of statistical methods such as regression, including their assumptions and limitations.
Clear communication and collaboration with stakeholders across disciplines.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Master's degree in one of the fields above.
Exposure to task mining, process mining, or workflow analysis.
Experience designing or analyzing experiments or other evaluations of operational changes.
Experience combining quantitative findings with qualitative data, such as interviews or surveys, and familiarity with measurement validity, psychometrics, human factors, or organizational research.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.
Familiarity with Tableau or Power BI and cloud data tools such as Snowflake, Spark, or AWS.

About Motivo
Motivo is a project-based company delivering excellence in mechanical and electrical system design and prototype builds. About The Role
Motivo is looking for diverse Mechatronics Engineers to join our team as we work on some of the most interesting challenges in a variety of domains.
An engineering role at Motivo means broad ownership and education. There are no “cogs in the machine” here. You’ll be responsible for ideation and feature definition, system level design, client and vendor relationships, and hands-on hardware bring-ups. You’ll have a seat at the table with CEOs/CTOs and have a voice to contribute to product strategy and viability. We are a premium engineering consultancy and our clients’ success depends on you being involved and shaping the big picture.

Success at Motivo is largely driven by hard-work, creativity, and collaboration. For mechatronics engineers, we expect baseline proficiency and/or professional experience within electrical, mechanical and/or software engineering.

Job Details
Job Description:
Embark with us on a journey of growth and transformation as we create exceptionally engineered technology and bring AI everywhere. As a valued team member, your adaptability and attention to detail will contribute to our drive for results and relentless pursuit of quality, ensuring we meet our customers' needs with precision.
Join us and build on our legacy of innovation and collaboration as we deliver world‑changing technology that improves the life of every person on the planet.
Life at Intel: https://jobs.intel.com/en/life-at-intel
At Intel's Logic Technology Development (LTD), we have continued to extend Moore's law to be world leaders in computing technology. To achieve the necessary scaling of our semiconductor manufacturing process, we have led the industry in developing enhancements such as strained silicon for carrier transport enhancement, high-k metal gates, FinFETs, and next-generation Gate-All-Around architectures. LTD has been at the center of every new development that has kept Moore's Law moving forward.
Defect Metrology plays a key role in the development of every new silicon process technology. Our analysis builds the plan that allows LTD to take technology from the research phase to the high-volume manufacturing phase while maintaining high-quality standards. In the Manufacturing Integration Engineering (MIE) organization, we engineer world-class yields on advanced processes by driving defects down to Best-in-Class targets.
As a Defect Metrology Engineer, you will be responsible for identifying all defects that impact yield and performance in an advanced silicon process technology. You will characterize the process using cutting-edge metrology tools. With this characterization, you will be responsible for investigating the root cause owners and developing defect reduction roadmaps to achieve program milestone commitments to our customers. You will then work directly with the process modules and integration teams to drive that roadmap by developing and qualifying process fixes through Model-Based Problem Solving (MBPS). You will also respond to defect baseline shifts to isolate the root cause and implement preventative actions consistent with 8D methodology. This role provides an opportunity to influence Intel's future process technologies that will keep Moore's Law moving forward.
Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To
Owning a segment of the process to ensure adequate metrology is placed to detect and respond to all yield-limiting defects prior to reaching end-of-line sort.
Investigate and respond to exclusionary baseline shifts to ensure segment defect health is restored to capable, demonstrated baseline.
Develop new recipes and RFCs as part of New Product Introduction (NPI).
Provide navigation and leadership to meet Intel's yield objectives, utilizing state-of-the-art metrology tools and test vehicles (QTM, Short Loop, etc.).
Organizing and presenting defect summaries to F25, LTD, MDCE engineering teams.
Partnering with Intel Integration, Yield, and failure analysis labs to provide root cause for all defect issues.
Hold the team and collaborators accountable for quality through Integrated Module Team (IMT) and Focus Team (FT) forums.
Work collaboratively as a part of the overall LTD Defect metrology group.
Role-model and establish a team culture of trust, collaboration, safety, accountability, and sustaining excellence.
Build strong relationships with other LTD teams based on mutual trust and respect.

Strong data analysis and problem debug skills.
Team player with flexibility and adaptability to changing business needs.

Complex problem-solving methodologies: root cause analysis, Model-Based Problem Solving (MBPS), 5 Why, Fishbone diagrams, or 8D frameworks.
Understanding of semiconductor physics or semiconductor processing cleanroom unit operations.
Understanding of defect metrology tools such as brightfield, darkfield, or voltage contrast (VC).

description_preview:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About The Team
Radar helps businesses prevent payments fraud and abuse while enabling legitimate customers to transact with confidence. We combine machine learning and AI with the intelligence of Stripe’s global network to make sophisticated fraud prevention accessible to businesses of all sizes.
Our work spans payments fraud detection, protection against abuse beyond the payment, enterprise APIs that bring Radar’s capabilities into businesses’ own systems and payment flows, and the platform that powers it all. We build everything from reliable, low-latency infrastructure to intuitive tools that help users understand threats and control how they respond.
Fraud evolves constantly, and so do we. We work directly with users to understand emerging attacks, turn advances in ML and AI into effective defenses, and build products that protect and grow their revenue.
What you’ll do
As a software engineer on Radar, you’ll build products and infrastructure that help businesses understand and stop fraud and abuse. Your work will span backend services, enterprise APIs, and user experiences that put sophisticated prevention capabilities into our customers’ hands.
You’ll own problems from investigation through launch, partnering with product managers, designers, and data scientists. You’ll have opportunities to scale systems that make real-time decisions across Stripe’s global payments network, bring advances in ML and AI into production, and build new products from scratch. Every improvement can have a direct impact on the revenue our users retain and the legitimate customers they serve.
Responsibilities
Build and operate reliable, low-latency services that detect and prevent fraud and abuse at scale
Design APIs and dashboard experiences that help businesses investigate threats, configure defenses, and understand how Radar protects them
Develop the shared platform and infrastructure that enable teams to build and launch new Radar capabilities
Work directly with users to understand emerging threats and turn those insights into broadly useful products
Partner with ML engineers and data scientists to bring new signals, models, and AI capabilities into production
Own projects end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and iteration
Uphold a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, and product craft while moving quickly as threats evolve
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum Requirements
2+ years of industry software engineering experience
Strong coding skills in any programming language, with experience building and maintaining production software
Ability to work across systems and technologies, learn unfamiliar codebases, and make thoughtful technical trade-offs
A rigorous approach to problem solving, including using data to investigate issues and evaluate whether a solution works
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across disciplines and contribute to your peers’ success
An ownership mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity, taking initiative, and following through on user problems
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building distributed systems or real-time services with demanding reliability and latency requirements
Experience building APIs, developer platforms, or intuitive user interfaces for complex workflows
Experience bringing ML or AI capabilities into production software
Experience working on fraud prevention, abuse prevention, risk, or security
Experience taking a product from an early idea to launch and iterating directly with customers
Hybrid work at Stripe
This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).
In-office expectations
Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.
Working remotely at Stripe
A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.
Pay and benefits
The annual US base salary range for this role is $156,800 - $235,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales

description_preview:
About the Company
Our client is a Series B AI company, valued above $1B, whose agents do real work in a high-stakes, regulated professional domain. Founded in 2023, it has raised more than $100M, has grown from about 60 to roughly 150 employees this year and expects to keep growing quickly. The team is based in New York City.
About the Role
Own end-to-end projects that bring intelligence into production. You will be responsible for systems that help agents reason, plan and evaluate themselves, with full autonomy to plan projects, define success, run experiments and decide when a system is ready to ship. This role suits engineers who want to operate like researchers and builders at once.
What You Will Do
• Design and iterate multi-agent architectures, encoding autonomy boundaries, tool use and fallback behavior that make agents safe and reliable.
• Build scalable offline and online evaluation pipelines that run hundreds of experiments, with golden tasks, labeling strategies and metrics.
• Instrument the stack to detect regressions, track error taxonomies and drive closed-loop improvement.
• Engineer context and retrieval: prompt stacks, indexing pipelines and parsing of messy documents into structured representations.
• Scope projects clearly, write concise specs and communicate progress within your pod.
What We Are Looking For
• Four to twelve years as a machine learning engineer, with end-to-end LLM-based agent applications including benchmarking, orchestration and evaluations.
• Experience at a fast-paced startup (Series A to D), a quant or hedge fund, or a top-tier technology company.
• Experience running structured ML experiments and building evaluation infrastructure.
• A CS, Physics, Math or related technical degree from a top school. The role is applied rather than research-focused.
• A very clear communicator who can break complex ideas down.
• Currently located in the US or Canada, ideally on the East Coast.
Bonus Points
• Deep Python expertise and LLM or transformer-based systems.
• Interest in the impact of AI on professional services and the economy.
Compensation and Benefits
$175,000-$350,000 base salary plus highly competitive equity, depending on experience. Visa transfers and sponsorship are available.
Location and Work Model
Full-time and on-site five days a week in Flatiron, New York City.

title: Cybersecurity AI Forward Deployed Engineer - FDE - Consultant
reason: Stack +33; Title fit +6; Entry +15; Exp fit +6; US +10; Overqualified -45
description_preview:
We Are
Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond, and recover along with all points of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business in every industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, turnkey solutions tailored to our client's needs across their entire value chain. Whether we’re defending against known cyberattacks, detecting and responding to the unknown, or running an entire security operations center, we will help companies build cyber resilience to grow with confidence. Our team of the security sector’s brightest people uses the coolest tech to out-hack the hackers and help clients build resilience from within. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security, and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.
Do you have the deep functional and technical experience to help implement security solutions that align with our clients’ business objectives? Do you have the expertise to design and deliver solutions for establishing system user's credentials, and processes for applying those credentials to access enterprise systems and applications?
You Are
This is not a security consulting role. It is not a compliance advisory position. It is not a pen test engagement. A Cybersecurity Forward Deployed Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client’s enterprise—shoulder to shoulder with their security and engineering teams—to make AI systems secure, governed, and resilient in real, complex organizational environments. You own outcomes: reduced attack surface, production-safe AI deployments, measurable security posture improvement.
Agentic coding is not a supporting skill for this role—it is the primary method of delivery. You use Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot as your standard operating environment. You build security tooling, detection systems, threat models, and governance frameworks with AI co-authoring the code alongside you. Engineers who treat AI tools as optional accelerators are not the profile. Engineers who cannot deliver without them are.
The Work
Cybersecurity FDEs operate as part of Accenture’s Reinvention Delivery Engine (RDE) Pod: a small, persistent, outcome-oriented team aligned to a client’s business domain or AI programme. The pod operates in 90-day delivery cycles, owns end-to-end outcomes across build, deploy, and optimize, and embeds directly inside the client’s technology organization.
Key Responsibilities
Support AI security architecture and threat modeling for production agentic deployments across complex multi-stakeholder client environments—LLM systems, multi-agent pipelines, RAG architectures, and MLOps infrastructure—owning the full security design from assessment through hardened deployment
Deliver hands-on security engineering using agentic coding tools as the primary build environment: build AI-powered detection systems, automated threat response tooling, security assessment frameworks, and governance automation using Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot in daily delivery practice
Support AI-specific threat surface management at programme scale: OWASP LLM Top 10 controls, prompt injection hardening, model extraction prevention, adversarial input defences, and AI supply chain security across concurrent client workstreams
Architect and govern AI security controls across the enterprise stack: identity and access for AI systems, data pipeline security, model serving security, and multi-system integration risk across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Assist with AI governance framework implementation: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and model risk management applied to live production systems, not theoretical compliance exercises
Shape AI reinvention security strategy for client CISO and CTO: build risk-adjusted investment cases, security architecture roadmaps, and AI governance operating models aligned to commercial outcomes
Define and publish reusable security patterns, playbooks, and accelerators that scale across multiple client engagements and grow the Secure AI practice
Contribute and support architecture design sessions, threat modeling workshops, and code-with sessions with client engineering and security leadership teams
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.
Here's what you need
Minimum of 3 years of engineering experience in production environments with a cybersecurity discipline depth in at least one area: AppSec, SecOps / detection engineering, cloud security, IAM, offensive security / penetration testing, or GRC
Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions in a production environment—non-negotiable; theoretical familiarity does not qualify
Minimum 3 years working with Cloud platform security fundamentals across at least one provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP): IAM, network security, secrets management, and AI service security configurations
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience
Professional Skills Requirements
Proven ability to communicate security risk in business terms: can translate threat exposure into risk-adjusted investment rationale a CISO or CFO would act on
Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below. We anticipate this job posting will be posted until 11/26/2026. Accenture offers a market competitive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)
This is a Stanford Health Care job.
A Brief Overview
The Product Engineer – AI/ML bridges technical strategy, hands-on software development, and applied AI delivery. Operating in a forward-deployed capacity, this role works directly with operational and clinical stakeholders to uncover root challenges, prototype solutions, and build high-value AI capabilities.
Unlike traditional product or project management roles focused solely on static specifications, the Product Engineer – AI/ML maintains end-to-end execution ownership—writing production-capable code, configuring AI model workflows (such as RAG and foundation APIs), and driving initial 0→1 implementation. Working alongside Data Scientists and Core Platform Engineering this role ensures AI solutions deliver measurable impact.
Locations
Stanford Health Care
What You Will Do
Partner directly with operational and clinical teams to probe and identify root-cause challenges rather than passively receiving feature requests.
Design, build, and iterate on working prototypes using programming languages such as Python, modern APIs, LLM orchestration frameworks, and retrieval systems.
Evaluate operational bottlenecks to determine whether simple automation, rule-based logic, or generative AI models represent the best technical approach.
Balance technical tradeoffs across model accuracy, execution latency, maintainability, and operational inference costs.
Integrate prototypes with health system data stores, enterprise APIs, and operational workflow tools.
Collaborate with Data Science teammates to pass solutions through formal evaluation harnesses prior to enterprise deployment.
Participate in constructing test suites to measure and mitigate model hallucinations, errors of omission, and factual inaccuracies.
Ensure alignment with healthcare data privacy policies, HIPAA regulations, and institutional AI governance standards.
Partner with Data and Software Engineers to transition validated prototypes to enterprise-grade platforms.
Education Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). Master’s degree preferred.
Experience Qualifications
3–5+ years of progressive experience in data science, software engineering, applied AI engineering, or technical product development.
Experience working in healthcare, health tech, or complex regulated enterprise environments.
Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities
Excellent communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
Knowledge and understanding of healthcare informatics related technologies and standards.
Proven ability to manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Preferred Knowledge, Skills And Abilities
Proficiency in Python and SQL; experience working with REST APIs, web services, and modern development workflows.
Hands-on experience with foundation model APIs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks.
Familiarity with enterprise data structures, cloud data platforms, and data privacy governance.
Strong ability to analyze operational workflows, probe for root causes, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Physical Demands and Work Conditions
Blood Borne Pathogens
Category II - Tasks that involve NO exposure to blood, body fluids or tissues, but employment may require performing unplanned Category I tasks

SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience

About Us
Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better-aligned superintelligences.
Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives.
We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us.
Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude.
About The Role
An RL environment is only useful once it runs reliably inside a lab's training stack. Every environment we build has to be packaged, sandboxed, run at scale, checked against each lab's requirements, and delivered in the format that lab's platform expects. Much of that work is still manual today, and it takes time away from the people designing environments.
As an
MTS on our ML Platform team
, you will own the systems that take an environment from a builder's repo to a lab's training run. That includes Karotte, our open-source framework for defining RL environments, the internal platform that builds, runs, and reviews environments on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and the integrations that deliver them to each lab we work with. This is an engineering role where you will ensure what our Capabilities team builds runs and ships cleanly.
You'll join a small Platform team and work directly with environment builders and post-training researchers. In your first six months, success looks like a delivery path to each partner lab that is mostly automated: tasks marked ready get built, validated against that lab's requirements, and packaged without hand work. Our needs change quickly, so you'll also pick up other platform and infrastructure work as priorities shift.
What You Will Do
Own the integrations that deliver our environments to partner labs: build container images, match each lab's submission format, and automate the checks that confirm requirements are met before anything ships. Do the delivery work by hand where you have to, then automate it.
Build and maintain Karotte, our open-source environment framework, from API design through releases and migrations that keep existing environments working.
Run and scale the infrastructure that builds, runs, and grades environments, including containerized rollouts and grading across CPU, GPU, and TPU, VM-based sandboxing, and the resource limits and isolation that stop a model from gaming its own grader.
Build the internal tools environment builders use every day (CLI, docs, data catalog, access controls, and run monitoring) so they spend their time on environment design instead of infrastructure.
Partner with environment builders and post-training researchers to turn recurring pain points into platform features, and ship quickly in response to their feedback.
What We are Looking For
Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of building and operating production infrastructure or developer platforms that other engineers depend on.
Proficiency in Python, including writing libraries and APIs that other people build on.
Hands-on experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar) and at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or similar).
A working understanding of how to run untrusted code safely: isolation, resource limits, and what happens when a process fills the disk or refuses to exit.
Extensive hands-on use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), and an intuition for where models cut corners.
You've owned something tedious end to end, such as a migration, a release process, or a delivery pipeline, and automated away as much of it as you could.
Nice to Have
Experience building RL environments, eval harnesses, or agent benchmarks (Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench, or similar).
Familiarity with RL post-training and inference stacks (verl, Ray, SkyPilot, vLLM, SGLang, or similar).

You've built sandbox or code-execution infrastructure (microVMs such as Firecracker, gVisor, or similar) at an infrastructure startup or frontier lab.
You've been an early platform or infrastructure engineer at a startup and built the internal platform the rest of engineering relied on.
You've worked as a forward deployed or integrations engineer, getting your company's software running inside customers' own environments.
You've built developer tooling or internal platforms used by ML researchers, even outside a formal ML role.
You've maintained an open-source developer framework with real external users.

About Motivo
Motivo is a project-based company delivering excellence in mechanical and electrical system design and prototype builds. We have a history in successfully taking concepts through to actual finished solutions. Our work spans a wide range of market segments including mobility/automotive, aerospace, robotics, and clean energy, to name a few. Every team member will experience a wide variety of challenging projects, offering rich opportunities for professional growth. We are passionate about solving complex engineering challenges, striving for excellence within every unique project constraint, and believe in having fun while we do it!
About The Role
We are looking for a passionate, enthusiastic multidisciplinary engineer, capable of leading the technical decision-making process in electro-mechanical projects that require a solid system architecture.
What is a Systems Engineer? At Motivo, these are some of our most highly valued and versatile team members. The ideal Systems Engineer is someone who understands what it takes to execute on an electromechanical project from concept to fabrication. People with those skills are often creative, balance competing priorities well, and have a high degree of attention to detail. A Systems Engineer typically works with a Project Manager and Technical Lead to guide a focused team of engineers into the beginning phases of a product development program. Together, this group is responsible for planning the technical and programmatic aspects of the development, defining or reviewing the complete system architecture, identifying key components and technologies, and leading the technical team to successful project completion. Often, in later phases of the program, the Systems Engineer will lead brainstorms, review the work of other engineers, provide guidance along specific technical paths, and help debug and troubleshoot during integration.
A strong Systems Engineer candidate will know enough about mechanical, electrical, and software engineering, as well as physics in general, to speak intelligently about all of them and understand their interactions. This candidate can often be an individual contributor across a variety of engineering tasks. The Motivo Systems Engineer position is the ideal role for an exceedingly sharp engineer who is insatiably curious about all aspects of engineering!
Qualifications
Below is a list of proficiencies and exposures we look for in Systems Engineering candidates, though we don’t expect that suitable candidates will have experience with every item in the list.
Hard Skills And Experiences
Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline (Master’s preferred)
Three or more years of professional engineering experience (7+ years for senior role consideration)
Direct technical experience on multiple electro-mechanical projects
Deep understanding of physics and electro-mechanical control systems
Extensive detailed design experience in either mechanical, electrical or software systems
Experience working with design tools and environments similar to ours:
Simulation and controls development (we use Matlab/Simulink)
SPICE platforms for electronics simulation
3D CAD (we use Solidworks)
PCB design (we use Altium)
C/C++ for firmware development (we typically use STM32 MCUs for custom embedded hardware)
Higher-level software development (Python and C/C++ most often)
Strong ability to take a client’s desires/requirements and develop a system architecture and technical roadmap
Ability to generate technical drawings of systems, components, and interfaces
Experience with troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis of issues in electromechanical systems
Soft Skills And Experiences
Exceptional communication skills; able to present results and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders
Strong ability to lead and support a team of engineers through technical challenges
Solutions and execution focused; ability to make trades against competing priorities
Open to new ideas and challenges from the team
Reacts well to changing client needs
Ability to mentor less experienced colleagues
Ability to handle concurrent fast-paced projects with minimal direction
Exceptional English speaking ability and good-for-an-engineer writing skills

description_preview:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
Job Description
Are you passionate about building scalable customer success technology that enables customer retention, expansion, and business growth? We're looking for a
Gainsight Administrator & Developer
to help transform how we engage, support, and grow our customer base. You will be a strategic technology partner to Customer Success, Sales, Operations, and IT. Your responsibilities will include designing and optimizing Gainsight solutions that enable proactive customer engagement, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making. You'll guide platform innovation, automation, integrations, and adoption while helping shape the future of our digital customer success strategy. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Customer Success, this hybrid role can work out of one of our North American locations.
Your Responsibilities
Drive Customer Success Technology Innovation
Design, configure, and continuously improve Gainsight capabilities including Customer 360, Health Scores, Success Plans, Journey Orchestrator, Rules Engine, Playbooks, CTAs, and Dashboards.
Build scalable customer success programs that support onboarding, adoption, risk management, renewals, retention, and expansion initiatives.
Develop solutions that enable Customer Success Managers to proactively identify opportunities and customer risks.
Lead Automation & Digital Engagement
Create automated workflows, customer journeys, playbooks, and business processes that improve efficiency and consistency across the customer lifecycle.
Use Gainsight's automation and AI capabilities to reduce manual effort, surface applicable insights, and improve customer outcomes.
Partner with business stakeholders to evolve and scale digital customer success programs.
Integrate Systems and Improve Data Visibility
Lead the development and optimization of Gainsight integrations with Salesforce and other customer success platforms.
Develop data models, integrations, automations, and reporting structures that ensure accurate customer, ARR, adoption, and renewal insights.
Champion data quality, governance, and system performance across the customer success technology ecosystem.
Partner Across the Business
Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Analytics, and IT teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Be the trusted advisor on customer success process design, platform optimization, and technology strategy.
Provide user enablement, documentation, troubleshooting, and best practices that maximize adoption and business value.

Are you passionate about building scalable customer success technology that enables customer retention, expansion, and business growth? We're looking for a

Lead Automation & Digital Engagement

Integrate Systems and Improve Data Visibility

Develop data models, integrations, automations, and reporting structures that ensure accurate customer, ARR, adoption, and renewal insights.
Champion data quality, governance, and system performance across the customer success technology ecosystem.
Partner Across the Business
Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Analytics, and IT teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Be the trusted advisor on customer success process design, platform optimization, and technology strategy.
Provide user enablement, documentation, troubleshooting, and best practices that maximize adoption and business value.

Bachelor's Degree in Relevant Field

Experience supporting SaaS, recurring revenue, or customer success operating models.

Expertise with:
Rules Engine

Scorecards & Health Scores

Success Plans

Experience integrating Gainsight with Salesforce and related business systems.
SQL skills including data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.

Experience supporting enterprise-scale Customer Success organizations.

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
The Experience
Systems Engineer is responsible for administering and managing the Finance systems & applications that support our mission critical business processes. Systems Engineer will be the primary process expert in their service area and will work in collaboration with developers, business stakeholders, and other technology teams in support of Salesforce end to end business processes. Daily activities will include, but are not limited to, enterprise application support, resolving technical and functional system issues, performing trend analysis and identifying enhancements to reduce support requests, and collaborating with development teams to implement new and enhanced functionality. The successful candidate must be agile and able to support multiple priorities.

SaaS Applications Administration (Coupa, Concur)

Manage users, roles, profiles and security settings.
Maintain data quality, integrity, and overall platform health.
Manage vendor releases, upgrades, and new capabilities.
AI Automation & Workflow
Demonstrate experience through AI/agentic workflow transformation, including redesigning processes to incorporate AI agents alongside human support engineers.
Identify opportunities to automate manual business processes and improve operational efficiency.
Monitor existing automations and troubleshoot failures or performance issues.
Data Management & Integration
Support data migrations, imports, exports, cleansing, deduplication, and data quality initiatives.
Work with integration teams to support Salesforce integrations with ERP, marketing, middleware, and other enterprise applications.
Understand APIs and integration concepts sufficiently to troubleshoot and coordinate integration issues.
Production Support & Troubleshooting
Provide Level 2/3 support for Salesforce issues.
Analyze and resolve complex configuration, automation, data, security, and integration issues.
Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive solutions rather than relying on workarounds.
Release & Change Management
Manage sandbox environments, testing, UAT, deployments, and production releases.
Coordinate with developers, QA, integration teams, and business stakeholders for major changes.
Maintain appropriate documentation for configurations and business processes.
What You'll Actually Be Doing
6+ years of SAP Concur or Coupa experience with expertise in configuration & application maintenance.
Understanding of Procure to Pay process areas (Purchasing, Accounts Payable, Expense Management etc).
In-depth knowledge in SAP Concur Expense or Coupa Purchasing & Invoicing modules.
Knowledge of Cognos Reporting tool.
Knowledge of SAP Concur Travel, Request is a plus.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to multi-task and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment
Able to think independently and consider cross-functional and downstream impact
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
be your best
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
do your best
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
